rationale.conceptual: The method is the authors' own anisotropic PFC extension with explicit but non-trivial derivations (anisotropic gradient, coefficients, vicinal rotation). Translating the model into working code requires understanding of several interacting components and careful numerical treatment; it is not a standard off-the-shelf method.
rationale.execution: The pipeline comprises parameter computation, domain initialization, running six independent 2D simulations, and extracting critical thickness; this gives 4–5 stages with data dependencies. No external tooling or env beyond NumPy/SciPy is needed, but orchestrating the simulations and avoiding trivial errors in discretization is non-trivial.
